title: Dental, Vision & Preventive Care Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=withings:eye) OR (index=personal sourcetype=opendental:appointment)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="withings:eye","primary",sourcetype="opendental:appointment","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from withings:eye and opendental:appointment to see whether two dental, vision feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `withings:eye` and `opendental:appointment` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main dental, vision data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
